column7: Phase 2: a custom role had no assignable scope, so one meant for projects could be granted globally (applying in every project), and a system role could be granted at a project. models.Role.AssignableScope (global|project|any) decides; new custom roles default to project, existing ones were backfilled to any, built-ins seeded (project_* project, system_* global). Widening is fail-closed like a permission add (TestSecurityMutationAudit_UpdateRoleAssignableScope_ByDirection).
